column1: # A person's decisions on amendments, applied over what the build reads from
# the amending articles (internal/amend). One row per amended article:
#   apply   the change is right: apply it (and add it if the build missed
#           it; the new wording is then taken from between the amending
#   reject  the build or the model misread it: don't show it (the pattern
#           pass's change and the model's link alike)
#   repeal  the amending article repeals the article: apply it as a repeal
#           (also when the build couldn't name the text, or missed it)
# Columns: the amending text's Centre id and article, the amended text's
# Centre id and article, the decision, a note.
